architecture.coverage_catalog: WearableBodyCoverageCatalog stores rig-specific semantic body coverage separately from canonical equipment occupancy.
architecture.coordinator: LayeredBodySuppressionCoordinator consumes the complete snapshot, unions/sorts coverage regions and applies one composite material.
